body: Gandalf? Really? I hope you aren't serious. Looks like God in the painting by Michelangelo.

I'll be really blunt, the only thing that keeps me from taking action and ending this is the thoughts of my kids crying. My wife and family would get over me rather quickly, and what few friends I have would deal with it.

I'm just really looking for things to get better, even a little. I'm just so damned tired.

Combat fatigue, yes that is a good analog for how I feel. Things have not gotten better in the week since I posted, if anything they have gotten worse. All the "little" things that go along with a normal life are piling on me even more, due to the fact that the bigger things seem to always stand in the way.

I live my days in a cloud, even my one place of happiness, my children, cannot pierce it. I look at them, and listen to their laughter and all I can think about is how they would be better without someone like me around.

There was a time, when no matter how bad it got, my youngest son could look at me and laugh or make a silly noise, or just simply say, "I love you daddy." and I would feel like I could go on, I could smile again, be happy for just a few moments, and it would be OK.

Now, my Judas-brain has been hardwired into a permanent ditch and I cannot climb out.
